description: Use this tool for the published School sequence of one learning language in class-1, class-2, or class-3. Class 1 returns lessons only for a language with a published lesson track, in curriculum order. Class 2 and Class 3 return published exercises and share the class-page URL. If Class 1 is empty, the reason is no-published-class-1-track. No lesson is invented.
